notes: Two taḥwīl branches («ح») meet at Ibn Jurayj; the names after the last «ح» (عطاء, جابر) are written once and belong to both branches, so they are the shared tail
«- واللفظ لابن رافع -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«قال لي عطاء سمعت جابر» makes Ata' a link (rule 5); Jabir is the Companion whose report is the saying
